About the residency

Porte Rouge is a small artist-run residency in a converted farmhouse in rural Burgundy. We host four artists at a time for four weeks, with private studios and a shared kitchen. The residency is open to artists of all disciplines, including sound artists and composers; a piano and a small recording booth are available.

Eligibility

The open call is international and open to artists aged 21 or older with a sustained practice. Students currently enrolled in a degree program are not eligible.

Fees and support

Each resident receives a stipend of €800 and travel support of up to €300, reimbursed after the residency upon presentation of receipts. Accommodation is included. There is an application fee of €20.

How to apply

Send a CV, an artist statement, a short project proposal (500 words max) and 10 images of recent work or up to 3 links to video or audio. Two letters of reference are required.

Questions: hello@porterouge.example.org
